procedure: one mutant at a time: apply a one-site text substitution to a production file or the generator, run the listed suites in order until one fails, restore the file in a finally; a clean baseline run must pass first; every anchor must occur exactly once (--anchors).
history: first full run: 49 killed, 3 survived (S3-M05, S3-M06, S3-M23). S3-M05 and S3-M06 were real test holes (no COMPLETE hidden-future twin; no CONTINUATION whose source transaction exists) and were closed by two new integration tests; S3-M23 is an equivalent mutant. Those three and S2-G10 were re-run against the final tests and merged into this file.
